summary: Executed full backend smoke suite against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 25 of 26 checks passed. Auth (bearer + unauth 401 + invalid session_id 401), Units CRUD + RBAC, Operations CRUD + auto-computed total_jam + operator scoping + unit not found 404, Payroll (auto gaji_bersih, admin-only mutations, operator own scope), Spareparts (admin mutations, operator 403, delete admin), Dashboard summary shape, User role management (admin PATCH, invalid role 400, operator PATCH 403). One HIGH-priority bug: POST /api/auth/logout does not invalidate bearer-token sessions (only clears cookie). One MEDIUM: PATCH /api/units/{id} requires all fields (not truly partial).
passed: POST /api/auth/session invalid session_id -> 401 {detail: Invalid session id}
GET /api/operations operator sees only own (1 record, operator_id=user_op_test)

failed.issue: POST /api/auth/logout does NOT invalidate a bearer-token session. After calling logout with Authorization: Bearer test_operator_token (no cookie), the endpoint returned 200 but the subsequent GET /api/auth/me with the same bearer token still returned 200 instead of 401. Root cause in /app/backend/server.py L235-239: logout() only reads session_token from Cookie and never inspects the Authorization header, so bearer-token sessions are never deleted from db.user_sessions.
failed.evidence: POST /api/auth/logout -H 'Authorization: Bearer test_operator_token' -> 200 {"ok":true}; immediately after GET /api/auth/me with same bearer -> 200 (expected 401).

failed.issue: PATCH /api/units/{id} rejects partial updates. Sending only {unit_name:'...'} returns 422 requiring nomor_lambung and serial_number. PATCH semantics should allow partial fields; either accept partial body or document that full body is required (or switch to PUT).
failed.evidence: PATCH /api/units/{id} body {unit_name:'EX-Test-01-updated'} -> 422 with pydantic 'Field required' for nomor_lambung, serial_number.

action_items: Fix logout: in /app/backend/server.py logout() also accept Authorization: Bearer <token>; reuse get_current_user's token extraction to delete matching user_sessions row.
Make PATCH /api/units/{id} accept a partial-update pydantic model (all fields Optional) so admins can update one field at a time.
